summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature e2e test of Python Academy (Pyodide, localStorage SPA). All 14 scenarios from the review request PASSED. Curriculum now has exactly 27 topics / 135+ exam Qs / 13 projects, matching dynamic landing stats. New topics (fileio, testing, pandasadv, prompting), per-topic YouTube video block with play toggle, key-takeaways, personal notes (persist across navigation), curriculum search + filter buttons, and per-question exam hint buttons all work. Regression happy path (/learn/intro -> /exam/intro pass -> unlock variables) still works (100% score).
critical_code_review_comments: Lesson.jsx line 47 accesses meta.yt without null-checking meta — getTopicMeta has a fallback so currently safe, but the optional-chain style used elsewhere (meta.takeaways?.length) would be more consistent.
Exam.jsx q{i}-hint text for fill/output says 'has 1 characters' (no pluralisation) — purely cosmetic.
Lesson.jsx trailing `void saveState;` is a dead-import workaround; cleaner to remove the unused import.
Notes are stored under a separate localStorage key 'notes:{topicId}' (not inside py_academy_v1) — works, but means notes aren't included in a single export/import of state if that's ever added.
seed_data_creation: Seeded py_academy_v1.completed with basics topics (intro..collections) to unlock /learn/fileio for verification. Note typed into notes-textarea and confirmed persistence after navigating away and back.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review items covered. Confirmed: Landing hero stats ['27','135+','13'] derived from data; 27 topics total; 4 new topics rendered; curriculum-search filters by title (typing 'pandas' shows 2 matches: 'Pandas DataFrames' + 'Pandas Advanced'); curriculum-search-clear resets input; filter-all/unlocked/locked/completed counts 27/1/26/0 on fresh state; video-block with play-video-btn swaps in an iframe (src=https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/...) on click; yt-search-link opens youtube.com results in new tab; takeaways-block renders 3 bullets; notes persist across navigation; q{i}-hint-btn reveals q{i}-hint with type-specific text (MCQ='only N options'; output/fill='has N characters and starts with X'); /exam/intro pass unlocks /learn/variables; /exam/fileio renders 5 questions; /learn/fileio shows video+takeaways+notes once prerequisites are passed; Projects page shows 13 cards incl. p10-p13; Certificate page gated with 'Complete all 27 topics' and 'Progress: 7 / 27' after seeding 7 completions.
